sections.title: Develop faster with the document model
sections.description: Our JSON-like document data model maps to the objects in your application code. Its flexibility allows you to model for a wide variety of use cases while also enabling you to easily evolve your data structures.

sections.description: Our unified query API is the most natural way to work with data in any form. Atlas extends MongoDB's flexibility and ease of use to building full-text search, real-time analytics, and event-driven experiences. Build a wide range of application services while keeping your data architecture simple.

props.heading: Built for the way you work with data
props.subheading: Our platform is built by developers, for developers. That means giving you the flexibility to work with the languages and tools you prefer to use.

tabs.description: Create a cloud database in seconds using the Atlas UI, CLI, Kubernetes Operator, or an Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) resource provider. Play around with a free cluster, launch a flex tier instance, or customize a dedicated cluster configuration.

snippets.code:
#Install the Atlas CLI
brew install mongodb-atlas

#Sign up for an Atlas account and configure your Atlas database
atlas setup

git clone https://github.com/mongodb-developer/get-started-aws-cfn
cd get-started-aws-cfn

# Deploy MongoDB Atlas CFN Resources into your AWS Region
aws configure set region eu-west-3
./get-setup.sh
./get-started.sh

<PUBLIC_KEY> <PRIVATE_KEY> <ORG_ID> <GETSTARTED_NAME> 

# Connect to your cluster
GETSTARTED_NAME="get-started-aws-quickstart"
MDB=$(aws cloudformation list-exports | \
 jq -r --arg stackname "${GETSTARTED_NAME}" \
 '.Exports[] | select(.Name==$stackname+"-ClusterSrvAddress") | .Value')
echo "Found stack:${GETSTARTED_NAME} with ClusterSrvAddress: ${MDB}"

# Test AWS IAM connection
./test-iam-mongo-connection.sh NewRoleBased-1
Found stack:NewRoleBased-1 with ClusterSrvAddress: mongodb+srv://cluster-1.5hmwe.mongodb.net
STACK_ROLE={
    "StackResources": [
        {
            "StackName": "NewRoleBased-1",
...
MongoDB shell version v4.4.1
connecting to: mongodb://cluster-1-shard-00-00.5hmwe.mongodb.net:27017,cluster-1-shard-00-01.5hmwe.mongodb.net:27017,cluster-1-shard-00-02.5hmwe.mongodb.net:27017/admin?authMechanism=MONGODB-AWS&authmechanismproperties=AWS_SESSION_TOKEN%3AIQoJb3JpZ2luX2VjEMv%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2F%2FwEaCXVzLWVhc3QtMSJIMEYCIQDQ4mV7RtfYCLrQwBg
...
PRIMARY>

# Deploy Atlas Kubernetes Operator to watch all namespaces.
kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/<version>/deploy/all-in-one.yaml

# Create a secret with your API keys and organization ID
kubectl create secret generic mongodb-atlas-operator-api-key \
    --from-literal="orgId=<atlas_organization_id>" \
    --from-literal="publicApiKey=<atlas_api_public_key>" \
    --from-literal="privateApiKey=<atlas_api_private_key>" \
    -n mongodb-atlas-system

kubectl label secret mongodb-atlas-operator-api-key atlas.mongodb.com/type=credentials -n mongodb-atlas-system

# Create the AtlasDeployment custom resource.
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: atlas.mongodb.com/v1
kind: AtlasDeployment
metadata:
  name: my-atlas-cluster
spec:
  projectRef:
    name: my-project
  deploymentSpec:
    name: "Test-cluster"
    providerSettings:
      instanceSizeName: M10
      providerName: AWS
      regionName: US_EAST_1
EOF

translate: MongoDB Atlas | The Modern, Multi-Cloud Database
MongoDB Atlas is the #1 modern, multi-cloud database that accelerates and simplifies how you build with data. Get started for free today!
Learn why MongoDB was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ <mark>Learn more ></mark>
Voyage AI joins MongoDB to power more accurate and trustworthy AI applications on Atlas. Learn more >
MongoDB 8.0: Experience unmatched speed and performance. <mark>Check it out ></mark>
Atlas combines the flexible document model with a suite of data services to give you a versatile cloud database that simplifies everything you build.
Illustration of a booklet with various documents.

Master MongoDB Atlas quickly with guided webinars, interactive courses, skill badges, and comprehensive documentation—all designed to simplify your onboarding and accelerate success. Start building with confidence, faster.
TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS OF ORGANIZATIONS, INCLUDING
Develop faster with the document model

Our JSON-like document data model maps to the objects in your application code. Its flexibility allows you to model for a wide variety of use cases while also enabling you to easily evolve your data structures.
Atlas architecture diagram highlighting key value pairs, relationships, objects, graphs, and geospatial within the Document Model category.
Work with data as code for any use case

Our unified query API is the most natural way to work with data in any form. Atlas extends MongoDB's flexibility and ease of use to building full-text search, real-time analytics, and event-driven experiences. Build a wide range of application services while keeping your data architecture simple.
Atlas architecture diagram highlighting transactional, search, time series, mobile, and analytical within the Unified Query API category.
Scale your workloads securely and confidently

A trusted foundation is at the core of everything we offer. Start with built-in data security and recovery defaults, then add the controls you need. Run applications anywhere in the world with the global and multi-cloud reach of Atlas.
Atlas architecture diagram highlighting security, multi-cloud, and distributed architecture within the Platform Foundation category.
